name: Chestnut Ridge
blurb: This community formed when several groups embraced their mutual connection to Horses and the land. The area soon became known as a hub for all things Equestrian, set against a beautiful and expansive landscape. Over time, the area became famous for another endeavor, as the rich soil brought in the new enterprise of Nectar Making.

neighbourhoods.name: New Appaloosa
neighbourhoods.desc: The historic New Appaloosa serves as a hub for Horse Riders, Ranchers, and Nectar Makers. Whether competing at the Hay Now! Equestrian Center, enjoying a night out at the dance hall, or savouring Nectar with good friends, this old watering hole has something for everyone.

neighbourhoods.name: Riders' Glen
neighbourhoods.desc: Watched over by the Trusty Steed Rock, known as "Ol' Biscuit" to the locals, Riders' Glen has been home to generations of Ranchers and Nectar Makers.

neighbourhoods.name: Galloping Gulch
neighbourhoods.desc: Lauded as one of the go-to regions for Horse Riding, the Gulch is chockfull of gorgeous trails and stunning outlooks.

weather: Snowy winters, heat waves in summer

highlights.name: Explore Dreadhorse Caverns
highlights.text: Located in the southwestern corner of Galloping Gulch quietly nestled beneath some trees, Dreadhorse Caverns is a vast cave full of bats, bears, and giant spiders! Dance battle your way down further and further into the abyss! Solve riddles, collecting rare reward items, and find the underground land of the unicorns! How deep can you go?

highlights.name: Go Horseback Riding
highlights.text: The trails in Galloping Gulch offer incredible views and sweeping vistas. Take your horse out and enjoy the sights and sounds, find places to camp and light a fire, or spend the night hunting for the mysterious ghost horse that haunts the park.

highlights.name: Rare Fishing Spots
highlights.text: Find incredible fishing spots with some of the rarest fish you'll ever catch in your life! There's no better place to cast out a line and let yourself relax and unwind from the hustle and bustle of daily life.
